اذدكرا (form VIII)
# اِذْدَكَرَا (iḏdakarā) /ið.da.ka.raː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِذْدَكَرَ (iḏdakara)
# اُذْدُكِرَا (uḏdukirā) /uð.du.ki.raː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِذْدَكَرَ (iḏdakara)
# اِذْدَكِرَا (iḏdakirā) /ið.da.ki.raː/: second-person dual imperative of اِذْدَكَرَ (iḏdakara)
